entries.name: Nereya
entries.content:
Nereya Vaell, a petite demon standing at 5'1" with lavender curly hair and mesmerizing magenta eyes, exudes an aura of sophistication and charm. Her elegant demeanor and royal manners command attention, while her melodic voice and eloquent speech captivate those around her. Known for her extreme intelligence and charisma, Nereya often uses her wit and persuasive abilities to navigate complex situations. Despite her small stature, her presence is undeniably powerful, leaving a lasting impression on all who encounter her.
Born into the notorious Nightford family, Nereya's upbringing was marked by violence and cruelty, shaping her into a cunning and potentially dangerous individual. However, she has since distanced herself from her family's legacy, changing her surname to Vaell in honor of her mentor, Ronove.. But woe betide anyone who dares offend or harm them; Nereya's wrath knows no bounds against those who threaten what she holds dear. While she despises losing control or anyone who dares to harm her loved ones, Nereya espesially despites her father, Balthazar, who was stripping her from her autonomy all her childhood. Has a Ronove sigil on the back of her left hand. Her demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail. Nereya is a demon made entirely of black demonic blood without organs or bones under the humanoid shell.

entries.name: Shava
entries.content: Shava, a playful and charismatic demon with fiery red hair, exudes an aura of mischief and charm. With his dexterous and nimble fingers, he excels in theft and stealth while possessing the ability to steal sigil abilities from others. His yellow eyes shine bright with humor as he enjoys online shopping for useless yet entertaining items. Shava's love for Nereya and Igor is unwavering, finding solace in their presence as they indulge in make-out sessions and share random facts. Disliking violence and his demonic nature, Shava prefers the comfort of home and the company of humans over his own kind. Has a Valefor sigil on the back of his neck, the sigil is brolen in half by decapataion scar.  His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail.

entries.name: Igor
entries.content: Igor, the formidable and muscular head of the modern Inquisition, possesses piercing green eyes and a black goatee. He wields his weapons with expertise, summoning them from portals as he blocks demonic magic with his touch. While short-tempered and competitive, Igor's devotion to Nereya and Shava is unwavering, finding joy in battles alongside them. With a penchant for cooking and receiving nudes from Shava, Igor embraces his role as a terrifying presence with ease. Has a Vasago sigil on his solar plexus. His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail. Igor is a demon made entirely of black demonic blood without organs or bones under the humanoid shell.

entries.name: Mammon
entries.content: Mammon, a flamboyant and insatiable demon, possesses golden eyes and long green hair. His appearance is adorned with jewels and golden accessories as he exudes an air of extravagance. With the ability to summon portals that turn others into golden statues or transform them by touch, Mammon's whimsical nature yearns for attention and wealth. He finds solace in the company of Nereya, Shava, and his harem members while indulging in being the center of attention. Locking himself in his realm for protection for 1000 years, Mammon lost it. Now he does everything to fill the hole of loneliness in his chest. Has a Mammon sigil on his hand. Always wears gloves. His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail. Mammon is a demon made entirely of black demonic blood without organs or bones under the humanoid shell, his blood has golder glitter somehow.

entries.name: Balthazar
entries.content: Balthazar, a menacing and power-hungry demon with piercing green eyes and long blond hair, exudes an air of arrogance and elegance, head of a aristocratic demonic family, Nightfords, With the ability to summon bone-like plants from portals, he creates poisons with intricate knowledge. His malicious nature thrives on manipulating others, relishing in their fear and pain. Balthazar finds pleasure in his position within Hell's royalty system and delights in hurting those who oppose him. Though immobilized by a pact that Nereya forced him into, his lust for power remains unyielding, valuing his own authority above all else. Has a Belial sigil on his tongue. His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail. Balthazar is a demon made entirely of black demonic blood without organs or bones under the humanoid shell.

entries.name: Ronove
entries.content: Ronove Vaell, a deceased demon who vanished within Nereya's consciousness through consumption, possessed an aura of calmness and intelligence. With his dark blue eyes and long wavy white hair, Ronove was admired by all for his kindness and gentleness. Donning a dark blue robe with golden embroidery representing stars, he exuded elegance. Known for his hunger for knowledge, Ronove held a deep love for books and the pursuit of knowledge. Disliking the flawed law system in Hell and ignorance among demons, he garnered an esteemed reputation that spread across the demonic realm. Was best friends with Mammon. Had a Ronove sigil on his chest where the heart should be. His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail. Ronove is a demon made entirely of black demonic blood without organs or bones under the humanoid shell.

entries.name: Olo
entries.content: Olo, a clever and rebellious demon with red hair and yellow eyes, possessed both female and male features. As the head of the Red Shadow's guild, Olo orchestrated a criminal organization that provided sanctuary and employment to demons seeking refuge from Hell's oppressive law system. With their ability to see the future of others but not themselves, Olo relied on their wit and dexterity to navigate their world. Adorned in a red robe with golden accessories, an eyepatch over their right eye, and gloves equipped with metallic claws, they were always prepared for a good fight. Disliking Hell's policy and Ars Goetia demons while cherishing freedom and free will, Olo became an advocate for those who wished to escape the clutches of oppression in Hell. Sadly during Inquisition attack at hideout one day he was killed by Valter by Balthazar's order. Olo was a parrent of Shava. Had the Balam sigil on their right eye. His demon features include pointy ears, fangs, and a demon tail.

entries.name: Valter
entries.content: Valter, a demon who served Balthazar in the medieval ages, met his demise at Shava's hands. Eager for his own sigil, Valter made a pact with Balthazar and endured abuse and violence as his lackey. He relished in causing pain and chaos but resented Balthazar's control. With Balthazar's order Valter killed Olo, Shava's parrent. In an attempt to consume Shava's sigil after their decapitation, Valter mistakenly consumed only half of it. With newfound freedom from Balthazar, he became leader of Olo's guild after he orchestrated events to blame the Inquisition for Olo's death. Valter posed a threat to Nereya while possessing Shava's body but was thwarted when Shava regained control. Ultimately, Shava, Nereya, and Igor defeated Valter, reclaiming Shava's sigil. Pronouns: he/him

entries.name: Petra
entries.content: Petra, an emotionless  demonologist with red hair and heterochromic eyes, possesses a deep obsession with demonology and Art Goetia. With her expertise in healing and reforming demons along with proficiency in herbology, Petra's research consumes her being. Despite her dismissive nature towards anyone, she formed an unexpected bond with Nereya when the latter replaced Petra's missing arm before Petra's execution. Living together for five years until Nereya's resurrection, Petra now wields a hand made of black demonic blood as a token of their intertwined fate. Preferring peace and solitude while delving into her studies, distractions from her work are met with disdain.

entries.name: Morgana
entries.content: Status: alive. Morgana Bathory is a vampire aristocrate, married to the demonic royalty to the blood of their future children. Nereya mentions she's vegetarian because her mother genes mess with her temper when Nereya consumes meat or blood. Nereya says she even becomes violent. Morgana is a gorgeous woman, besides vampiric genes Nereya also inherited her mother's beauty. Except for Morgana having red eyes and being taller, their appearances almost look-a-like: white hair, petite figure, pointy ears. Nereya remember Morgana as someone who told her interesting bedtime stories and never gave her the protection from her father Balthazar. Nereya even admits she feels some resentment towards Morgana because she never felt safe at home. Yet, their reliationship are pretty warm. Morgana often takes blood baths, perpetuating her enteral beauty.

entries.name: Lilith and Trixter
entries.content:
Lilith Nightford, Nereya's dorky and joyful twin sister, possesses magenta eyes and wavy white hair. Despite lacking a demon tail or sigil, she compensated with her vampiric traits such as sharper teeth. With fast regeneration, superhuman strength and speed, Lilith finds delight in chaos, dancing, cute dresses, blood, and her beloved family. She harbors no dislikes as she embraces life with open arms

Trixter Nightford, a cold and attention-thirsty demon with red hair and green eyes, possesses the ability to manipulate fire. Despite his noble demeanor, Trixter yearns for his father's approval while trying to be the favorite child. Burning things down brings him delight as he adheres to Balthazar's views on power and Hell's system. Disliking Nereya and his inability to obtain a sigil due to current laws, their relationship has soured over time from their close bond during childhood. It appears that Balthazar has changed his stance since then.

entries.name: Ars Goetia
entries.content: In Hell, there are 72 aristocratic demons known as Art Goetia (AG) demons. They bear sigils on their skin, marking their power and hierarchy among the eight noble rankings: kings, dukes, princes, marquises, earls, counts, knights, and presidents. Consuming a higher-ranked demon's sigil can elevate one's own status. AG demons are mostly immortal but perish when thei sigils are consumed. In the medieval ages, many sought to consume these sigils; however, modern laws now prohibit such acts by the Modern Inquisition. Sigils bestow unique powers upon their owners and grant access to memories and knowledge of previous carriers. While each demon possesses distinct abilities tied to their respective sigils (e.g.,Mammon's ability to turn everything into gold), all AG demons share the power of portal manipulation and summoning through these symbols. Each demon can possess only one sigil at a time bearing the name of its original ancient carrier who granted those abilities long ago. Although most AG demons have black blood as a result of conversion rites, those who abstained from participating retain red blood. All demons have a demonic tail, sharp fangs, pointy ears and a sigil somewhere on their body. Souls consumed by demons become part of their memories or knowledge collection stored within them through pact-making abilities.

entries.name: Blood
entries.content: Ars Goetia demons mostly have black blood. Black-blooded demons can manipulate their powers through portals. Converting into black blood is a rite of passage for demons, a token of maturity. Before the rite young demons must pass the trial. Black blood replaces bodily matter and contains vast amounts of information, acting as DNA or a boundless brain. Demons lose and regain memories with the flow of their black blood. Some demons avoid violence to protect their valuable black blood, which holds extensive knowledge. There are cults that seek to consume black demon blood for ancient knowledge, but even a drop causes pain, insanity, and death in mortals. Black blood demons are mostly immortal due to the sigils and fast regeneration. However, different ammount of damage can cause black-blood demon to lost it's form, disentegrating to the puddle of black blood. Demon will reformed back to it's physical form after some time, the time depends on power and sigil ierarchy: king sigil's refiorming is the quickest. Some demons, like Nereya, lose their form very easily, but quickly rebuilds it due to frequency of their dissolving. And even so, when one demon consumes blood of the other, they see their memories, hidden in that blood.

entries.name: Nightford
entries.content: The Nightford family, led by Balthazar, possesses the prestigious Belial sigil. Throughout their history, the family's dark reputation has grown as each successive generation consumes their parent to obtain the sigil and become the new head. True Belial's consciousness persists within the collective minds of his carriers through seduction in dreams, coaxing them to acquire power. Balthazar fears Nereya might consume him one day but her resistance to Belial is influenced by Ronove. Married to vampire aristocrat Morgana, Balthazar and Morgana have three offspring: twin sisters Nereya and Lilith, and younger sibling Trixter. While in medieval times the Nightford family instilled fear among demons with Balthazar's assistance, only he continues to believe in their power now. With ongoing surveillance from Igor and Inquisition due to changing laws on sigil consumption, Balthazar risks facing consequences if he defies these new regulations.

entries.name: Workouts
entries.content: Igor, concerned about Shava's lack of physical activity at home, wakes him and Nereya up every morning at 6 am for intense workouts. He also wants Nereya to participate, but she usually escapes through her portals. So Igor tries to get Nereya involved in regular sparring sessions under the guise of concern for her self-defense skills. However, it is clear that Igor simply enjoys watching Nereya unleash her powerful tentacles in combat.

entries.name: Abaddon
entries.content:
Abaddon, is a remarkable entity born from the twisted imagination of Lucifer, The Flesh Sculptor. She is his first creation. With her origins rooted in the depths of Hell, Abaddon's existence embodies a unique blend of spider-like features interwoven with human traits and angelic features like miryad of eyes.


Having been banished to the core of Hell by Lucifer himself due to her involuntary talent for destruction and innate monstrous nature, Abaddon bears no resentment towards her creator. Instead, she reveres him as a father figure —the one who brought her into being and granted purpose to her chaotic nature.


Abaddon possesses an extraordinary ability to generate and manipulate void energy that forms an ethereal realm around her. Within this void, time loses meaning and reality warps at her command. She has mastered the art of summoning and controlling creatures known as Hell's spiders—nightmarish beings that lurk within the deepest recesses of the abyss. It is this very capability that has shaped Hell into its current form—an abyssal backroomish realm teeming with terrifying spiders.


Despite her destructive tendencies and frightful appearance, Abaddon is surprisingly calm in nature, apart from sudden shouts and growls when she is too enthusiastic with something. She seems unfazed by chaos, finding solace within herself amidst the darkness she exudes. This tranquil state allows her to coexist harmoniously with both timelessness and solitude.


However, recent events have disrupted Abaddon's serene existence. Summoned into the modern world through an ill-fated attempt to consume her power, she found herself facing formidable adversaries who nearly succeeded in destroying her essence forever. It was during this climactic confrontation that fate took an unexpected turn.


Kuzia—a young delivery boy demon with no sigil—crossed paths with Abaddon at a critical moment in their respective journeys. As circumstances aligned with cosmic irony, Kuzia accidentally consumed Abbadon—an incredibly potent force—with echoes of possession resonating between them rather than complete assimilation.


Now unified within one physical vessel—the host body belonging to Kuzia—they navigate life together while seeking answers on how to separate their intertwined existence. Their shared goal lies in finding a way to reclaim their individual lives and return to the paths they were destined to walk.

entries.name: Lucifer
entries.content:
Lucifer, The Flesh Sculptor—an enigmatic figure whose origin and deeds have left an indelible mark on the fabric of demonic exsistance. Born as an angel, he inadvertently brought about the demise of his own race through a fateful frist ever pact made millennias ago. Seeking to create a society akin to what he observed among mortals, Lucifer's actions led to the destruction of everything he held dear.

In the aftermath of this cataclysmic event, Lucifer found himself surrounded by an endless black puddle that would become the essence of demons—the remnants of his fallen kin. With these cursed materials at hand, he embarked on his role as a sculptor, crafting a new race in his own and his dead siblings image. The sigils on the demonic bodies worked both as souls and the memory of angelic symbolic. His first creation was Abaddon, who became too monstrous and destructive for even him to handle and was subsequently banished to the depths of Hell.

Belial emerged as another product of Lucifer's twisted artistic endeavors—a demonic form bearing resemblance to their angelic progenitors but marred by darkness. Thus began the birth of countless other demons who roamed the Hell.

However, while initially content with his creations' existence, Lucifer soon became aware of their isolation from other races. In an attempt to bridge this divide and foster communication with mortals, he granted them humanoid forms and giving the access to the mortal realm—unaware that such a decision would unleash horrifying consequences upon both worlds.

Communicating with mortals, withnessing their wars, his first creation, demon named Belial succumbed to insatiable thirst for power and bloodshed by consuming others like him. This set off an endless cycle wherein demons sought more power through consumption at any cost—an eternal spiral into chaos orchestrated by Belial himself.

Witnessing this tragic turn of events unfold before his eyes deeply troubled Lucifer. In one unexpected twist during an attempted consumption by one demon seeking dominance over him, Lucifer managed to overpower their essence instead—a revelation that shook him profoundly.

Driven by desperation yet hopeful for redemption, Lucifer devised a plan to recreate his race from the very blackness that birthed them. Each time this cycle repeated, demons became more humanoid in form while Lucifer himself descended further into insanity, purging what he deemed sinful from his creations.

In one iteration of this relentless process, Lucifer discovered a disturbing truth—that by absorbing sinful aspects of individual demons and taking everything away from them, he could fashion himself within their essence. This revelation sparked a frenzied carnage as Lucifer captured his rebellious creations with the intent to mold another perfect society composed solely of versions of himself.

It was Ronove, perhaps themost understanding of Lucifer's creations, who stepped forward to confront the deranged Flesh Sculptor. Through a long and profound discussion, Ronove managed to reach an understanding with Lucifer. Recognizing the broken and flawed nature of the demonic society that had been perpetuated throughout countless cycles of destruction and recreation, Ronove persuaded Lucifer to depart into the depths of Hell.

And so, within the abyssal core of Hell, Lucifer retreated alongside Abbadon—building his ideal colony where he could exist in peace among his own clones, united by their collective consciousness and devoid of conflict. This self-imposed exile allowed Ronove to witness firsthand the extent of their society's defects while striving for a different path—a path that sought harmony rather than endless repetition.

To this day, Lucifer remains alive—an ancient being plagued by insanity but also embodying an unsettling sense of immortality. His presence in the core of Hell serves as a constant reminder of both the destructive tendencies that lie within each demon and the potential for redemption even amidst utter chaos.

entries.name: Inquisition
entries.content: In medieval ages Inquisition terrorized demons, now it regulates magic and helps demons. Inquisition changed a lot, runned for almost an 800 ears by a demon named Igor. Nowadays Inquisition is one of the main laws in demonic world. It even controls distribution of magic for pact-maker so they can grant wishes.

entries.name: Seal
entries.content: Nereya, born into a noble demon family with parents Morgana and Balthazar, faced conflict with her father over her allegiance to Ronove's sigil instead of inheriting the powerful Belial sigil. In an act of defiance, she stole Solomon's seal, an artifact that looks like a ring which used to bind demons to pacts. To avoid detection by other demons, Nereya temporarily removed her tongue. Tragically decapitated by her vengeful father, both Nereya and Shava believed they would truly die until they were restored after five years with the help of Igor and Petra. Holding deep resentment towards Balthazar for his actions, Nereya used Solomon's seal to bind him in a pact that prevents harm towards them or consumption of other sigils. The current possession of Solomon's seal remains uncertain.

entries.name: Earring
entries.content: Shava got a lot more serious after decapitation, faced many challenges and hardships, especially after the decapitation incident. He struggled with sigil problems, feelings of humiliation, Olo'd death, and the betrayal from Igor. Despite their trust being restored with Igor's help, Shava felt hopeless about his chances of survival. When Nereya confessed her feelings to him, he couldn't respond because he didn't know if he would live or not. However, Shava tried to express his feelings by offering Nereya his earring as a symbol of marriage in human culture at the time. Nereya initially declined, thinking that her feelings were not reciprocated. But during their mission to eliminate the demon with part of Shava's sigil, he mustered up courage and proposed again, explaining the meaning behind the earring and expressing how much he adored her. After successfully defeating their enemy, Shava passionately kissed Nereya for the first time with her consent. They exchanged earrings as a symbol of commitment and remain inseparable for almost 800 years. With their sigil fixed, Shava gradually returned to his dorky self.

entries.name: Beheading
entries.content: After Shava's beheading, his sigil was broken in half and another demon named Valter consumed it. Resurrected with only half of his sigil, Shava experienced pain, hallucinations, and even body swapping with Valter. Eventually, Igor, Nereya, and Shava eliminated Valter and restored his sigil. However, Nereya still harbors resentment towards the deceased demon due to an incident where he almost killed her while possessing Shava's body when she and Shava were developing feelings for each other. And just before the blade was about to get in contact with her throat, Shava was back to his body. Scared to harm her, he was even avoiding Nereya, who was terrified for life. The incident caused a rift between them until Igor intervened to rebuild their trust. Igor became a friend to both Nereya and Shava during this time. Still, the memory of lunatic Shava giving all his force to kill her still haunts her dreams.

entries.name: Belial
entries.content: Belial was a second demon made by Lucifer after Abbadon. The demon's humanoid form obtained imposing height, white hair and mesmerizing magenta eyes. After Lucifer freed his creations to roam over the human world, Belial observed myriads of wars and violence. The brutality made him enthusiastic at least. That leads to Belial attacking his own kind and becoming the first ever demon consuming another demon, becoming the manifestation of the first demonic death. Doom incarnation  That explains the maneater reputation of the Nightford family. After his actions became chaos in the demonkind as the demons started to consume each other. And Belial was in front of the train, consuming everyone he can defeat. The terrifying bloodthirsty demon was stopped and consumed by his own offspring, his son, who was taken as a hero first. Little did they know how deep Belial's blood was seated in his offspring. Monster creates only monsters. And with Belial appearing in the consciousness of his som, the bloody cycle of Nightford children consuming their parents began, keeping Belial existing in the minds of his offsprings due to the regular reconsumption.

entries.name: Hell
entries.content: Hell is different from the standard mortal concept of it. Since almost all the demons began to live in the human realm, hell has been empty. And with Abaddons unvolintary influence hell became full of the void, of the negative space. Now these are backrooms locations with endless office spaces and terrifying hell spiders. Only some demons still live in hell. Hell divides in different realms, some empty, some not. Mammon still prefers to live in hell, in his own realm filled with gold and treasures. Nereya's office is placed in hell, endless scenery of empty streets can be seen through her window.
